query: For Arid Heights Research Annex Global Horizontal Irradiance (W/m²), historical cutoff 2022-02-08 23:00:00 and forecast window 2022-02-09 00:00:00–23:00:00, search separately for: (1) GHI sensor calibration, alignment, cleaning, downtime, logging, definition, firmware, and software changes through the cutoff; (2) temporary dust, weather, access, or maintenance disruptions and verified endpoints before the forecast window; (3) persistent atmospheric, instrumentation, or diurnal regime changes established before the cutoff; (4) scheduled events explicitly overlapping 2022-02-09; and (5) evidence testing robust_phase_template phase stability and amplitude constancy, holdout_adaptive_cycle_ensemble holdout representativeness and ranking stability, regime_damped_harmonics cross-cycle shape correlation and damped amplitude change, and validated_seasonal_median same-phase stability versus recent-level behavior. Reject other sites, non-GHI metrics, post-cutoff outcomes, undated current-period forecasts, and theoretical clear-sky values presented for the forecast date.

evidence.claim: An internal AHRA analysis recorded a 4.2% reduction in optical sensitivity immediately following the February 5 dust storm.
evidence.exact_quote: Data indicates a 4.2% drop in optical sensitivity directly following the storm event on Feb 5.

evidence.claim: Two optical sensors experienced maintenance outages on February 7 and returned online that same day.
evidence.exact_quote:
| Feb 7 | AH-OPT-01 | 08:30 | 11:45 | Lens resurfacing and seal replacement |
| Feb 7 | AH-OPT-02 | 12:15 | 14:00 | Particulate extraction from housing |

impacts.rationale: The documented optical-sensitivity change could contaminate the two-cycle history used by all four candidates, particularly assumptions that same-phase disagreement and recent cycle-amplitude changes represent latent GHI. The quote does not identify the affected GHI sensor, quantify the effect on recorded GHI, or establish persistence through 2022-02-09, so no numerical adjustment is justified.

The February 7 optical-sensor outages ended before the forecast window but may make phase errors, cycle shapes, amplitudes, and the latest holdout less representative. Because the disruption ended before 2022-02-09 and the quote supplies no effect on GHI values, it cannot justify a future multiplier or additive correction.

missing_information: Identification of whether AH-OPT-01 or AH-OPT-02 produced the target GHI series.
Verified magnitude and direction of any effect from the February 5 sensitivity loss or February 7 maintenance on recorded GHI.
A pre-cutoff endpoint showing whether optical sensitivity was restored before 2022-02-09.
Actual pre-cutoff hourly GHI evidence establishing phase stability, peak timing, cycle-range behavior, and same-phase versus one-step errors.
Earlier legitimate holdout results showing whether candidate rankings were stable and whether the latest holdout was representative.
Dated pre-cutoff evidence of any atmospheric regime or scheduled GHI-relevant event overlapping 2022-02-09.
